evidence: Labeled Mining and introduces src/node/block_template_manager.cpp, restructuring block template generation, tip waiting, and getblocktemplate RPC internals.
rationale: Consolidates fragmented block template construction and submission logic into a dedicated BlockTemplateManager, eliminating redundant full block copies during getblocktemplate calls. Reviewers note this establishes a clear boundary for mining interfaces, prevents dangling references at shutdown, and unblocks upcoming template improvements such as fee-inflow tracking.
